whyMatch: Vintage cover photo of Rap Masters magazine, November 1992 issue (Kris Kross cover). name: Penn Crusader

name: Pine Needle
source: University of Illinois HPNL / CCC Camp Newspapers Digital Collection (metadata only)
whyMatch: Confirmed as CCC Company 237(-C) camp newspaper, New Lisbon, NJ, continued by 'Sixty Niner (City)'. Digitized issues (Oct 1936, May 1937) exist in UIUC's CCC Camp Newspapers Digital Collection but access is restricted to UIUC affiliates -- no downloadable page image found.

name: Today's Black Woman
whyMatch: Only eBay listings found are for a later-era (2008-2009) 'Today's Black Woman' magazine of uncertain relation to the 1995 Paramus title; too weak to confirm as the same publication, so not counted as a match.
